“胡说八道！”

上官程没忍住爆了粗口：“这都什么乱七八糟的小道消息？我怎么——不是，他怎么可能是这种人？”

他深吸一口气，压住那股想掀桌的冲动，转过头，一脸严肃地看着霖多多，眼神真诚得像在发毒誓：“你不要信这些传言！上官程是会用些非常手段，但绝不是滥用，更不是不明是非。他处理那厨师，不是因为他放多了盐，而是因为他把食用盐换成了工业盐，想要害死上官程。”

那一次，他在ICU躺了半个月，出来后没直接要了那厨师的命，都算他仁慈！

“那老员工也不是因为一次PPT没做好就被打瘫的。而是他窃取商业机密，被保安发现之后情急跳楼，自己摔瘫的。”

他说着，一把抓住霖多多的肩膀：“这才是真相！你信我！那些传言都是一帮忌惮他的人故意抹黑他的！”

“行行行我信我信！”霖多多被他晃得脑袋直晃，龇牙咧嘴地拍他的手，“但你这么激动干什么？抓得我好疼啊！”

上官程这才意识到自己反应过激了，他干咳一声，飞速收敛表情，声音压得四平八稳：“我没有激动。我就是……看你们这么怕他，想安抚一下你们。

霖多多扶正眼镜，揉着被抓痛的肩膀，仰头看他：“这些信息你从哪知道的？”

上官程张了张嘴：“我……”

总不能说“我就是上官程本人，我给自己澄清”吧？

他卡壳的样子落在霖多多眼里，她眨了眨眼，半猜半问：“之前那些人告诉你的？”

上官程也没更好的答案，只能点头：“嗯。”

霖多多的眉头立刻拧了起来：“他们那么欺负你，你怎么能信他们的话？肯定是假的！说不准他们跟那青面阎罗就是一伙的！”

“玉面阎罗。”上官程小声。

霖多多没听清：“什么？”

上官程：“……没什么。”

彭源也凑了过来，一脸笃定：“阿九，你听的那些肯定不对！他哪有这么好心？要真像你说的那样，他怎么可能对我们提那么变态的要求？”

上官程蹙眉：“他给你们提了‘变态’要求？”他自己怎么一点印象都没有。

霖多多解释道：“酒店经理跟我们签完合同的时候，特意强调——大少爷要求非常高，千万不能出差错，也不能延期。哪怕有一个点没画好就要全部返工，每延期一天扣百分之十的费用。还有，要是最终成品不够档次，入不了他的眼，我们就别想在圈里混了。”

"Nonsense!"

Shangguan Cheng couldn't help but cursed: "What kind of nonsense is this? How could I - no, how could he be such a person?"

He took a deep breath, suppressed the urge to lift the table, turned his head, looked at Lin Duoduo with a serious face, his eyes were as sincere as a poisonous oath: "Don't believe these rumors! Shangguan Cheng will use some extraordinary means, but it is definitely not abuse, nor is he ignorant of right and wrong. He dealt with the chef not because he put too much salt, but because he replaced table salt with industrial salt and wanted to kill Shangguan Cheng."

That time, he lay in the ICU for half a month, and he didn't directly kill the chef after he came out. It was considered a mercy of him!

"The old employee was not paralyzed because he failed to do a good job on a PPT. It was because he stole business secrets, and after being discovered by security guards, he jumped off the building and became paralyzed."

He said, grabbing Lin Duoduo's shoulders: "This is the truth! You believe me! Those rumors are all deliberately discredited by a group of people who are afraid of him!"

"Okay, okay, I believe it, I believe it!" Lin Duoduo was shaken by him, and she grinned and patted his hand, "But why are you so excited? It hurts so much when you catch me!"

Only then did Shangguan Cheng realize that he had overreacted. He coughed dryly, quickly calmed his expression, and kept his voice steady: "I'm not excited. I just...see you are so afraid of him, so I want to comfort you.

Lin Duoduo adjusted his glasses, rubbed his scratched shoulder, and looked up at him: "Where did you get this information?"

Shangguan Cheng opened his mouth: "I..."

You can't say "I am Shangguan Cheng himself, let me clarify it for myself", right?

His stuck look caught Lin Duoduo's eyes, she blinked and half guessed, half asked: "What did those people tell you before?"

Shangguan Cheng didn't have a better answer, so he could only nod: "Yeah."

Lin Duoduo's brows immediately wrinkled: "They bully you so much, how can you believe what they say?It must be fake!Maybe they are in the same group as the green-faced Yama!"

“Jade-faced Yama."Shangguan Cheng whispered.

Lin Duoduo didn't hear clearly: "What?"

Shangguan Cheng: "...It's nothing."

Peng Yuan also came over, with a determined look on his face: "Ajiu, what you heard is definitely wrong!How could he be so kind?If it was really like what you said, how could he make such perverted demands on us?"

Shangguan Cheng frowned: "He made a 'perverted' request to you?"How come he has no impression at all.

Lin Duoduo explained: "When the hotel manager signed the contract with us, he specifically emphasized that the young master has very high requirements and must not make any mistakes or delay.Even if there is one point that is not painted properly, all the work will be reworked, and a 10% fee will be deducted for each day of delay.Also, if the final product is not high enough to catch his eye, we won’t be able to stay in the industry."
